responsibility: Adds the HP-UX 10.10 specialization on top of the generic PA HP-UX configuration. Its main job is to mark this OS revision and adjust STARTFILE_SPEC so non-shared links pull in the appropriate `unix95` startup object when UNIX 95 behavior is selected, distinguishing the older 10.10 runtime startup sequence from later HP-UX releases.
same_name_distinction: HP-UX 10.10 target header that marks TARGET_HPUX_10_10 and adjusts STARTFILE_SPEC; unlike pa-hpux1010.opt, it implements the startup-file behavior for that OS level rather than merely declaring the option that selects the UNIX 95 mode.
